overrides.why: Clover, Square, Shopify and Lightspeed perform their own POS offline payment recording; candidate is vendor-independent manual backup reconciling orders, alternative payment evidence, partial fulfilment and double collection across outages. Same buyer but not established substantially same end-to-end workflow across four direct rivals. A parallel standalone reconciliation competitor search is still required.

Aruba, InfoCert, TeamSystem, Namirial primarily provide legally-compliant e-invoice conservation; candidate is a multi-client legal deadline interpretation, vendor-delivery proof and discrepancy tracker rather than lawful archive provider. Same buyer but direct identical core job and workflow not established.

Veeva, Ennov, MasterControl and EXTEDO evidence centers on pharma/life-sciences regulatory submissions, whereas the candidate specifically names regulated consumer goods firms. Scope overlap is not sufficient to establish four SAME buyer class and substantially identical consumer-goods filing review workflows.
